questions.question: If an electron is travelling at 200 m/s within 1m/s uncertainity, what is the theoritical uncertainity is its position in μm ?
questions.explanation:
Question Explanation : 
We are to find the uncertainty in position (Δx) given the uncertainty in velocity (Δv = 1 m/s) of an electron.

Concept : 
Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle : Δx.Δp ≥ h/2

Solution : 
Given : 
Δv = 1 m/s
me = 9.1 × 10–31 kg 
h = h/2π = 1.055 × 10–34 J-s
Δp = m.Δv = 9.1 × 10–31 × 1 = 9.1 × 10–31 kg-m/s
Δx ≥ h / (2.Δp)
Δx ≥ 1.055 × 10–34 / (2 × 9.1 ×10–31)
Δx ≥ 5.8 × 10–5 m = 58μm

Final Answer : 
Option (3)
